name: non_slack_dispatches_while_slack_down
why: KNOWN DEFECT, frozen deliberately. The gate is COMPUTED per target (_target_needs_slack) but APPLIED globally: the first Slack-needing target sets the flag and the whole tick exits, so an email-only quest is stalled by a Slack outage it does not depend on. ~183 gate_slack_down events/day means this bites often. The golden records today's behaviour so the port is proven faithful first; fixing it is a separate, intentional golden change.
